What are the four pillars of OOP in Python?

Supplied answer
Encapsulation - keeping data and methods together and hiding internal details (private variables with
__). Inheritance - a child class reusing a parent class's code. Polymorphism - the same method name
behaving differently for different classes. Abstraction - exposing only what is needed, using abstract
base classes from the abc module.
